title: Munyengeteri weNzvimbo Tsvene
intro: Munguva dzehusiku dzakanyarara, mweya wakazvipira wakadana kuna Mwari weTsitsi mukati memasvingo matsvene enzvimbo tsvene. Makore ekutenda kusingazununguki nemoyo murefu akanga ava kuda kupiwa chishamiso chaizounza mufaro nenhaka yehuporofita.
clues: Ndakapedza mazuva angu nehusiku hwangu ndichizvipira munzvimbo tsvene, ndichinyengetera kuna Ishe wangu nguva dzose.
Ndakakwegura, uye mudzimai wangu akanga asina mbereko, asi handina kumborasikirwa netariro mutsitsi dzaAllah.
Ndakapiwa mwanakomana, ainzi Yahya, uyo akava muporofita uye chiedza chekururama.
Ini pachangu ndaiva muporofita, ndakatumwa kuzotungamira vana veIsraeri.
Ndaiva wedzinza reMuporofita Harun uye ndaishanda semupristi muTembere.
Ndakapiwa basa rekutarisira Maryam, amai vaIsa, uye ndakaona zvishamiso zvake.
